collection_methods: unauthenticated configured public Telegram preview pages
public RSS/Atom headline and excerpt feeds; no article-body scraping
limitations: No Telegram global search or private groups
No X, Facebook, YouTube or general news-site collection
Posts are unverified leads; publication date is not necessarily incident date
RSS availability and update frequency vary by publisher; errors are shown per source.
Only public feed headlines and excerpts are collected; full article content is not mirrored.
Articles are unverified source leads; publication time is not incident time.
Multiple articles may describe the same event and are not automatically independent corroboration.
No social-media platform beyond the separately configured public Telegram preview collector is searched.
summary.notice: Public Telegram preview posts and public RSS/Atom headlines/excerpts only. All items are unverified source leads; publication time is not incident time. Repeated coverage is not independent corroboration. This feed excludes analyst notes and incident decisions.
summary.archive_notice: Daily rolling archive merged from scheduled public-source collection runs. Coverage is bounded by public preview/RSS access and collector limits; this is not a complete record of all posts or news.
